texts.preamble: Prathamesh Prakash Gangan vs The Sr. Police Inspector And Anr on 18 March, 2026 Digitally signed by Laxmikant Laxmikant Gopal (5) Apl-49 Gopal Chandan Chandan Date: 2026.03.18 21:30:45 +0530 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Criminal Application No.494 Of 2026 Prathamesh Prakash Gangan : Applicant. Versus The Sr. Police Inspector, Malbar Hill Police Station and anr. : Respondents. ______________________________________________________ Mr.Mateen Shaikh a/w Ms. Muskan Shaikh for the Applicant. Mrs P P Bhosale, App for the Respondent/State. ___________________________________________________
texts.arguments: Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025. He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs. 4. Mrs. P.P.Bhosale, learned APP for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is subject matter of the Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Criminal Application. He submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
